annotations.title: Incidents, open now or recent; open outages and slowdowns carry the likely cause

description: Wraps GET /api/incidents. Incidents, open now or recent; open outages and slowdowns carry the likely cause. Call this to see what went wrong and why: open and recent incidents, newest first, with the likely cause on open outages and slowdowns. Page through with limit and offset.

kind.description: only these kinds, comma-separated: site_down,slow for outages and slowdowns

state.description: open: open now; recent: newest first, open or closed; resolved: closed ones only, newest first

name: incidents

items.description: A problem the monitor found, open or resolved

cause.description: what the check saw, in our fixed words (never the site's text)

details.description: the kind's own facts: counts, before and after values, the page (`page`), how it ended (`resolution`)

dismissed.description: the team marked it as noise: still open, never alerts again

domain.description: the domain, for domain incidents (expiry, DNS, the registrar's flags)

id.description: the incident's id, for /api/incidents/{id} and its writes

kind.description: what kind of problem: site_down, slow, page_broken, broken_links, … (label says it in words)

label.description: the kind in words, as the dashboard says it

clues.description: what points there: errors, other sites, where it was seen, pushes and changes just before

likely.description: the likely cause in a sentence; null when the rules found none

missing.description: why there's none: its checks were purged (they're kept RETENTION_DAYS) before a diagnosis was saved

likelyCause.description: outages, slowdowns and broken pages only: the monitor's rules, as in the alert; a resolved one's as saved when it ended

resolvedAt.description: when it ended (ISO 8601, UTC); null while it's open

severity.description: down: an outage, alerted at once; warning: something to fix

site.description: the site's slug; null for a domain's or project's incident

url.description: the page or file it's about; null when it's about the whole site or a domain

next_steps.description: calls that usually come next, each naming its tool

tool.description: the tool that makes this call

title: Incidents, open now or recent; open outages and slowdowns carry the likely cause
